name: library-webapp

dependencies.name: circulation-api
dependencies.description: The only backend the app calls: catalogue, loans, holds and fees.

description: Single React SPA with member screens (search, title detail, loans, holds, fees) and librarian screens (titles, copies, check out/in, holds queue, fees), gated by role. Signs in via SSO and calls only the circulation API. It holds no secrets and never calls the catalogue service.
